output.headline: Hires Jensen Hughes for up to $101,700 to design a new fire alarm at Hintil Kuu Child Development Center
output.summary: Jensen Hughes, Inc. of Concord will design a replacement for the existing fire alarm systems at the Hintil Kuu Child Development Center, including site visits, a review of current plans and drawings and surveys. The limit of $101,700 includes a $5,000 contingency fee. Work is scheduled from November 4, 2021 to June 29, 2024.

output.headline: Ratifies a no-cost agreement with Oakland REACH for programming at Sojourner Truth school
output.summary: This memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Oakland REACH sets out each side's duties for REACH programming and partnership at Sojourner Truth Independent Study School. The item states no dollar amount. It covers July 21, 2021 through June 30, 2022. The agreement period began before this vote, so the board is approving it after the fact.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $32,400 for a contractor to support drug and health education in classrooms
output.summary: An individual contractor will work up to 1,080 hours supporting teachers, in the Zoom and in-person classroom, on lessons about drug education, holistic health, and how race, law and politics affect youth incarceration and exploitation. Pay is capped at $32,400 for September 1, 2021 through June 30, 2022. The agreement period began before this vote, so the board is approving it after the fact.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $8,325 for Children Rising to tutor 2nd and 3rd graders at MLK and Lafayette
output.summary: Children Rising will tutor 2nd and 3rd graders in reading and math at MLK and Lafayette Elementary Schools from August 9, 2021 through May 25, 2022. The cost is capped at $8,325. The agreement period began before this vote, so the board is approving it after the fact.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $29,700 for a contractor to support drug and health education in classrooms
output.summary: An individual contractor will support teachers, in the Zoom and in-person classroom, on lessons about drug education, holistic health, and how race, law and politics affect youth incarceration and exploitation. Pay is capped at $29,700 for September 7, 2021 through June 30, 2022. The agreement period began before this vote, so the board is approving it after the fact.

output.headline: Adds $37,628 to Viatron's contract to catalog and reorganize Cole Administration Center files
output.summary: This amendment gives Viatron Systems, Inc. extra work on the Cole Administration Center Project: listing all files retrieved from district storage, building a new database log of them and putting them in alphabetical order. It adds $37,628.20, raising the contract limit from $308,795.00 to $346,423.20. All other terms stay the same.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $50,000 for School Services of California to lobby in Sacramento for OUSD
output.summary: School Services of California will represent the district's interests in Sacramento, including developing strategies, monitoring legislation and budget items that affect OUSD, and lobbying the Legislature and State Administration. The cost is capped at $50,000 for July 1, 2021 through June 30, 2022. The agreement period began before this vote, so the board is approving it after the fact.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $50,000 for a contractor to write and manage grants for the Chief of Staff's office
output.summary: An individual contractor will provide grant writing and management services, including writing grant proposals and reports, research, editing and coordinating grant submissions, for the Office of the Chief of Staff. Pay is capped at $50,000 for July 1, 2021 through June 30, 2022. The agreement period began before this vote, so the board is approving it after the fact.

output.headline: Hires Shah Kawasaki Architects for up to $1.13M to design the Coliseum Prep Academy expansion
schools: Coliseum Prep Academy at Havenscourt High School
output.summary: Shah Kawasaki Architects of Oakland will provide design services for the design-build site expansion of Coliseum Prep Academy at Havenscourt High School. The $1,125,011 limit includes up to $100,000 for additional services and up to $23,350 for reimbursable expenses. Work is scheduled from November 18, 2021 to March 31, 2025.

output.headline: Updates the district's law firm agreement to reflect the firm's new name, Davis, Bengtson & Young
output.summary: This amendment to the memorandum of understanding and engagement policy with Davis and Young Law Firm of San Jose only changes the firm's name to Davis, Bengtson & Young, APLC, effective July 29, 2021. All other terms stay the same, and no dollar amount is stated.

vendor.name: Davis and Young Law Firm (now Davis, Bengtson & Young, APLC)

output.headline: Approves $67.26M in payroll checks and direct deposits for July to September 2021
output.sourceIssueCandidate: The title says Fiscal Year 2021-2022, but the action text says Fiscal Year 2020-2021 for payments dated July 1 through September 30, 2021.
output.summary: The board approves the district's payroll payments for the first three months of the fiscal year: 3,021 printed checks and 24,009 direct deposits. The total is $67,260,334.53 for July 1 through September 30, 2021. Details are in Exhibits 1-4 attached to the item.

output.headline: Approves $64.8M in accounts payable checks issued July to September 2021
output.summary: The board approves the district's accounts payable payments (bills paid to vendors) for the first three months of the fiscal year. This covers 1,651 printed checks totaling $64,800,465.68 from July 1 through September 30, 2021. Details are in Exhibits 1-4 attached to the item.

output.headline: Approves up to $250,000 for Oakland Public Education Fund COVID-19 contact tracing, without bidding
output.summary: The board approves a resolution allowing a sole source exception to public bidding (the district skips competitive bidding because it names one provider) and a services agreement with the Oakland Public Education Fund. It covers COVID-19 contact tracing and related activities from August 15, 2021 through June 30, 2022, for up to $250,000.

output.headline: Approves up to $200,000 for Family Engagement Lab text messaging, without public bidding
output.summary: The board approves a resolution allowing a sole source exception to public bidding (the district skips competitive bidding because it names one provider) and a services agreement with Family Engagement Lab. The company will provide text messaging services to schools and to parents and caregivers from August 2, 2021 through June 30, 2022, for up to $200,000.
